title: shows no row of the old inspection once the engine restarts
why: The guarded reset removed: after the engine restarts, the routes read from the engine before stay on screen until the feed is read again.

title: keeps a mode chosen while its write is on its way, and moves when the record is read again
why: The mirror applied on every render where the controls differ from the record: a mode chosen snaps back to the record's before its write answers, and an operator chosen meanwhile goes with the old mode (issue 407).

title: keeps a mode chosen while its write is on its way, and moves when the record is read again
why: The mirror removed: a record read again, by Run all or a reopening, does not move the mode and operator selects.
